title: Measure Your Follow-Up Before Buying More AI
rights: Original educational script and typography-only slides written for APEX/RMC AI Workshop. Local CMU Flite slt narration; no third-party footage, music, images, testimonials or customer data.
description: A practical, no-cost baseline for a small service business before purchasing an AI receptionist, chatbot or extra automation. Map an opted-in inquiry through owner assignment, the first human reply and the next action; record the missing observations as unknown. All examples are fictional. This is an educational checklist, not a promise of sales or cost savings. Optional service inquiry only: https://apex-content-worker-production.up.railway.app/home-services (public checkout remains paused).

scenes.heading: Before buying another AI tool
scenes.text: First measure where a real inquiry goes.
scenes.narration: A new chatbot will not fix a broken handoff by itself. Before paying for another tool, map what happens after a customer chooses to contact your business.

scenes.heading: 1. Map one simple path
scenes.text: Opt-in inquiry → assigned owner → first reply → next action
scenes.narration: For a fictional cleaning company, start when a person requests a quote. Record where that inquiry arrives, who is responsible for answering, and what the next step should be.

scenes.heading: 2. Record three facts
scenes.text: Time received, response time, and follow-up owner
scenes.narration: Use a simple tracker. Write down when the opt-in request arrived, when the first response happened, and who owns the next action. If a timestamp is missing, mark it unknown.

scenes.heading: 3. Separate gaps from guesses
scenes.narration: A blank field might mean the event was not recorded. It does not prove that a customer was ignored. Confirm a small sample with your team before labeling a workflow broken.

scenes.heading: 4. Protect customer permission
scenes.text: Only use contact details for permitted purposes.
scenes.narration: Document the requester's consent and your privacy rules. Do not auto-message people who did not ask to hear from you. Use fictional examples when testing a new response workflow.

scenes.heading: 5. Test a seven-day baseline
scenes.text: Count opt-in requests, confirmed replies, and exceptions.
scenes.narration: Run a small seven-day sample before and after any change. Check for duplicates, missing handoffs and false alerts. A small sample is not proof that a tool increased revenue.

scenes.heading: A free first step
scenes.text: Start with a tracker, not a new subscription.
scenes.narration: Write one approved response template and a follow-up checklist. Test them with your team. RMC AI Workshop shares practical examples, and the APEX home-services page accepts optional inquiries without requiring a purchase.
